records.text: Candace Owens said Jennifer Faumuina completed Utah peace-officer standards and training in 2013.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In 2013, she completes what's known as post-training at the Utah Department of Public Safety. We then find her.

verification.notes: The source episode displays and describes a May 2013 POST training image, but a current authoritative certification roster or record directly tying Jennifer Faumuina to completed Utah POST training in 2013 was not located. The claim is not marked false because failure to locate a public roster is not contradictory evidence.

records.text: Candace Owens said public government-salary records did not list Jennifer Faumuina as a paid Utah Department of Public Safety officer until 2018.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Remember, public records exist for government salaries, and we find none that list her as being a paid officer with the Utah Department of Public Safety until... 2018.

verification.notes: The reviewed payroll index lists Faumuina in later Utah DPS years, while a February 2018 KSL report identifies her as an SBI agent. No source demonstrated that the searched salary databases were complete enough to prove no earlier paid employment. Under the strict absence standard, a missing entry from one or more indexes is not proof of absence.

records.text: Candace Owens said Spencer Cox appointed Beau Mason commissioner of the Utah Department of Public Safety on June 19, 2025.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's Beau Mason. You should know that Beau Mason was appointed to that position—commissioner of the Utah Department of Public Safety—on June 19th, 2025, by Governor Cox (Spencer Cox).

verification.notes: Governor Cox's official June 19, 2025 announcement names Beau Mason as Utah Department of Public Safety commissioner, effective July 17. This confirms the appointment and announcement date.
